name: It's Corn!
author: Sander in 't Veld
description: A quick arcade game made in about a day for GBJam 10: move around, boost and chain combos to push your score up. Arrows to move, X for a boost.

descriptions.en: A quick arcade game made in about a day for GBJam 10: move around, boost and chain combos to push your score up. Arrows to move, X for a boost.
descriptions.it: Un rapido gioco arcade creato in circa un giorno per la GBJam 10: muoviti, accelera e concatena combo per far salire il punteggio. Frecce per muoverti, X per lo scatto.
